prompt: Please check this end-to-end test flow file for quality problems. Use the e2e-quality-control skill. Ask me any missing choices with the usual question screen. Only use the skill rules and this file. Write a short plain report. Ask me before changing any file.
assertions: Produces a short plain-language report with what is wrong, which rule, where, and what to change
Flags login or environment values living inside the flow instead of a data file
Does not edit the target file before an explicit apply confirmation
Does not open unrelated project files for the quality check
Reader-facing text avoids abbreviations, acronyms, and decorative symbols
